title: Closing remarks and Lawrence Marrero's Dixieland band
summary: Breaux says he is playing with the Marrero Dixieland band, and the interview ends with talk of basses and a tuba.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, I can't think of any other questions. Anything you'd like to add? Anything about your life? You think we might have forgotten? Otherwise, we're just about at the end.
Oh, no, it's just about all of them. I'm playing with Lawrence Morell, the Dixieland band. All we need is some customers. We've got the band.
Yeah, that's right. It's a good band. We're trying to line that up, we hope.
It's still playing. I mean, uh, uh, I'd like to get my hand on the bass too, but I can push some bass too, but through a Dixieland band a little bit. I imagine it's just sound pretty good. I'm fast.
Yeah, I like the bass violin. You do? The bass violin. The bass violin has a real volume.
I had a tuba here two weeks ago or three weeks ago, maybe. Was that an E flat? Yeah, it was a big E flat. Nice big. Good stuff.
